name: bare-crypto

exports.name: constants
exports.description:
The supported algorithm constants: `hash` (hash algorithms), `cipher` (symmetric cipher
algorithms), `signature` (signature algorithms), and `keyType` (asymmetric key types).

members.name: Hash
signatures: new Hash(algorithm: HashAlgorithm | number, opts?: TransformOptions<CryptoHash>)

exports.name: createHash
signatures: createHash(algorithm: HashAlgorithm | number, opts?: TransformOptions<Hash>): Hash
exports.description:
Create a new `Hash` instance with the specified `algorithm`. `algorithm` may be a string (for
example `'sha256'`, `'sha-256'`) or a numeric constant from `constants.hash`. The `options` are
forwarded to the `Transform` constructor from `bare-stream`
(<https://github.com/holepunchto/bare-stream>).

params.name: algorithm
params.description:
The hash algorithm, as a string (for example `'sha256'`, `'sha-256'`) or a
numeric constant from `constants.hash`.

params.name: opts
params.description: Options forwarded to the `Transform` constructor from `bare-stream`.

throws.condition: `algorithm` is a string that does not name a supported hash algorithm.

members.name: Hmac
signatures: new Hmac(algorithm: HashAlgorithm | number, key: string | Buffer, opts?: TransformOptions<CryptoHmac>)

exports.name: createHmac
signatures: createHmac(algorithm: HashAlgorithm | number, key: string | Buffer, opts?: TransformOptions<Hmac>): Hmac
exports.description:
Create a new `Hmac` instance using `algorithm` and `key`. `key` may be a string or
`ArrayBufferView`. If `key` is a string, an `encoding` option (defaults to `'utf8'`) controls how
it is decoded. The `options` are also forwarded to `Transform`.

params.name: algorithm
params.description:
The hash algorithm, as a string (for example `'sha256'`, `'sha-256'`) or a
numeric constant from `constants.hash`.

params.name: key
params.description:
The HMAC key; a string is decoded using the `encoding` option (defaults to
`'utf8'`).

params.name: opts
params.description: Options forwarded to the `Transform` constructor from `bare-stream`.

throws.condition: `algorithm` is a string that does not name a supported hash algorithm.

members.name: Cipheriv
signatures: new Cipheriv(algorithm: CipherAlgorithm | number, key: string | Buffer, iv: string | Buffer, opts?: TransformOptions<Cipheriv>)

params.name: algorithm
params.description:
The cipher algorithm, as a string or a numeric constant from
`constants.cipher`.

params.name: key
params.description: The encryption key; must match the algorithm's required length.

params.name: iv
params.description: The initialization vector / nonce; must match the algorithm's required length.

params.name: opts
params.description:
Options forwarded to `Transform`; may include `encoding` (defaults to `'utf8'`)
and, for AEAD algorithms, `authTagLength` (defaults to `16`; must be `12`, `14`, or `16`).

throws.condition: `algorithm` is a string that does not name a supported cipher.

`key` or `iv` does not match the algorithm's required length, or (AEAD)
`authTagLength` is not `12`, `14`, or `16`.

members.name: final
members.description:
Finalize encryption. For AEAD ciphers, the auth tag becomes available via `getAuthTag()` after
this call.

params.name: outputEncoding
params.description: If provided, the final output is returned as a string in this encoding.

members.name: getAuthTag
members.description: Return the auth tag produced by `final()`. AEAD ciphers only.

params.description: The additional authenticated data.

params.name: opts
params.description: May include an `encoding` for string `buffer` inputs.

members.name: setAutoPadding
members.description: Enable or disable automatic padding. Block ciphers only.

params.name: pad

params.description: The encoding of `data` when it is a string.

params.name: outputEncoding
params.description:
If provided, the encrypted result is returned as a string in this

exports.description:
Create a new `Cipheriv` instance using `algorithm`, `key`, and `iv` (initialization vector /
nonce). `key` and `iv` must match the algorithm's required lengths. For AEAD algorithms (for
example `AES128GCM`, `CHACHA20POLY1305`), the `options` may include an `authTagLength` (defaults
to `16`).

params.description:

`constants.cipher`.

params.name: key
params.description: The encryption key; must match the algorithm's required length.

params.name: iv
params.description: The initialization vector / nonce; must match the algorithm's required length.

params.name: opts
params.description:
Options forwarded to `Transform`; may include `encoding` (defaults to `'utf8'`)
and, for AEAD algorithms, `authTagLength` (defaults to `16`; must be `12`, `14`, or `16`).

throws.condition: `algorithm` is a string that does not name a supported cipher.

`key` or `iv` does not match the algorithm's required length, or (AEAD)
`authTagLength` is not `12`, `14`, or `16`.

exports.name: timingSafeEqual
signatures: timingSafeEqual(a: ArrayBuffer | ArrayBufferView, b: ArrayBuffer | ArrayBufferView): boolean
exports.description:
Compare two `ArrayBuffer`s or `ArrayBufferView`s in constant time. Returns `true` if `a` and `b`
contain the same bytes, otherwise `false`. Throws a `RangeError` if `a` and `b` differ in byte
length. Use this whenever comparing MACs, signatures, capability tokens, or other secret-equality
checks.

params.name: a
params.description: The first buffer to compare.

params.name: b
params.description: The second buffer to compare.

throws.condition: `a` and `b` differ in byte length.

Sign `data` using `key`. `algorithm` selects the signing algorithm and must match the algorithm
of `key`. Resolves with an `ArrayBuffer` containing the signature.

params.name: algorithm
params.description: The signing algorithm to use; must match the algorithm of `key`.

params.name: key
params.description:
The key to sign with; must include `'sign'` in its usages, and must be a private
key for Ed25519.

params.name: data
params.description: The data to sign.

throws.condition:
`algorithm` does not match the algorithm of `key`, `key` cannot be
used for signing, or `key` is not a private key for Ed25519.

members.name: verify
signatures: verify(algorithm: 'HMAC' | 'Ed25519', key: CryptoKey, signature: ArrayBuffer, data: Buffer): Promise<boolean>
members.description:
Verify that `signature` is a valid signature over `data` for `key`. `algorithm` selects the
signature algorithm and must match the algorithm of `key`. Resolves with `true` or `false`.

params.name: algorithm
params.description: The signature algorithm to use; must match the algorithm of `key`.

params.name: key
params.description:
The key to verify against; must include `'verify'` in its usages, and must be a
public key for Ed25519.

params.name: signature
params.description: The signature to check.

params.name: data
params.description: The signed data.

throws.condition:
`algorithm` does not match the algorithm of `key`, `key` cannot be
used for verification, or `key` is not a public key for Ed25519.
